contexts.text: The third style of the Word... is scattered.
A stench of mice is disseminated from (such).
Then the things which are scattered appear beautifully coherent...
Those in good, although scattered through the whole world, are still one.
As these things are scattered...
To scatter clean waters () = the purification of the heart. AE 587:14.
(These things) to man... appear scattered. AC 7153:end.
The Societies which constitute (this man) are scattered through the whole world...
Let Moses sprinkle it towards heaven () = that these falsities were shown to those in Heaven... To sprinkle = to show.
The Lord's Church is scattered through the whole world, and yet is one. AC 8650. AC 9256:4. AC 9400:end. HH 328. DLW 25. DP 325.
In the sense of the letter, Things are scattered... AC 9200:end. AE 89.
Moses sprinkled the blood upon the people () = adaptation for reception by man (of the Divine truth)... To sprinkle = to inflow, thus to adapt.
The sprinkling of the blood at the foundation of the altar, represented the unition of the Divine truth and Divine good solely in the external man. Explained.

Thou shalt sprinkle it upon Aaron... () = the reciprocal unition of the Divine good and Divine truth in the higher Heavens... To sprinkle upon them = to unite; for that which was sprinkled and poured upon anyone represented unition.
He scattered it upon the faces of the waters () = a commixture with truths.
To scatter conjectures, fables, etc.
(The idea) seemed to me so scattered that nothing cohered; but still... the things insinuated into man... although they appear so scattered, in Heaven have a wonderful connection.
The Sirens so scattered their deceits...
Wherever she scattered her corporeal things...
So that the pebbles appear scatteredly.
The explications must appear as if scattered.
The blood sprinkled... = the [truth] proceeding.
